summary: Preferred minimum load per (delivery) stop; below it, penalties from costs apply.
range: Array of integers, same dimensions as capacity. Delivery jobs only. Soft — drives penalties, not infeasibility.
businessRules: Soft constraint: shortfall triggers costs.min_stop_load_fixed_penalty / _unit_penalty, does not force unassignment.

min_stop_load defines: Specifies the minimum load threshold that should be preferred to serve at a stop. When a task’s load is lower than this threshold, the optimizer applies a penalty (as defined by costs.min_stop_load…
Each element in min_stop_load must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity, vehicles.costs.min_stop_load_fixed_penalty. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: min_stop_load [5] with all deliveries >= 5 — no penalty.
Behavioral: a delivery below min_stop_load still assigned but incurs penalty.
Interaction: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Interaction: Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Interaction: Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
